name: Dover
description: Bring Dover's applicant tracking system into Claude. Post unlimited jobs across 100+ job boards, manage your candidate pipeline, coordinate interviews and scheduling, and track hiring progress across every open role directly within your conversation with Claude. Built for founders and hiring teams who want a faster, more streamlined way to manage recruiting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dover to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dover to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.dover.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dover MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dover provides these MCP tools: add_candidate_note, apply_candidate_tag, create_candidate_tag, find_candidate, get_candidate_tags, get_interview_prep, get_job, get_top_applications, list_candidate_tags, list_jobs, remove_candidate_tag, and update_candidate_stage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dover?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dover in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Dover requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dover is developed by Dover. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
